Title: Pi Coding Agent: The coding-agent harness you can make your own | Product Hunt
# Pi Coding Agent. ## The coding-agent harness you can make your own. Pi is a minimal terminal coding harness. Adapt Pi to your workflows, not the other way around. Ask Pi to build what you want, or install a package that does it your way. Pi is a minimal, hackable terminal harness for building the AI coding agent workflow you actually want. It keeps the core small and clean, then gives you the freedom to add, modify, or replace almost anything through extensions, skills, and packages. Context management, sub-agents, permissions, custom workflows — you can make it behave exactly how you like. Pi first caught a lot of attention as the harness underneath @OpenClaw. What’s really striking now is how strongly it’s showing up in the @OpenAI ecosystem. It’s cool to own your harness 🤓. We've wasted time fighting opinionated defaults in other coding agents, so shipping without sub-agents and plan mode by design is a real differentiator. Even though my ecosystem is more of shifted to KiloCode ocasionally and VSCode for the rest of self coding or building tasks, Pi agent does seem very useful for such a simple agent that you get to decide what it can or can't do and build from a simple base. Also the way it is handling chat forks is much better than other bots i have seen, Copilot is not that great while kilocode was better than copilot but this is the style i'd much prefer, asking questions to clarify in middle of chat and then turn back and continuing like we never did in first place, but made this interaction much more seemless. @Pi Coding Agent The customizable harness angle is interesting. I think coding agents get much more useful when teams can shape the workflow around their own review habits, instead of adapting everything to one fixed agent style. #### vs Alternatives. It's Open Source and adapts to my workflow. used Pi Coding Agent to build MausBot. Pi is one of the agent engines integrated into MausBot. Its integration gives users another agent option within the same local app and conversation workflow. #### Alternatives Considered. used Pi Coding Agent to build Side.

results.content:
Title: Harness by Autonomous: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center. | Product Hunt
# Harness by Autonomous. ## Every coding agent, every machine, one command center. Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Harness by Autonomous. We're excited to launch Harness on Product Hunt today and show you what we built. We run a lot of coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud. One thing bothered us: every agent sits in its own window on its own machine, stops to ask something, and just waits. What if all of them lived in one command center? 🖥️ Every agent, every machine, side by side in a native app for Mac and Linux. 📱 Answer your agents on the go with the Harness app, available now on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 🎁 Exclusive to the Product Hunt community: 20% off Harness devices, the always-on display by your keyboard, with code PRODUCTHUNT. I was confused at first but I extracted this "onboarding" from the main page without adding the harness and my agent almost bought a key (cute). * Harness runs the agents you already have, with your own accounts. So install the agent CLI first (Claude Code, Codex…). If it isn't signed in yet, it shows the agent's own login right there. can the relay be turned off entirely so it's machine to machine only?? - When it wakes: it comes back online on its own, and the app reattaches to the agent you had open. - For work that should never stop: start those agents on the always-on machine (harness new codex --machine desktop …). The app finds folders like ~/.codex\_work, or you can link one, so a personal and a company Codex agent can run side by side on one machine. Install Harness on the remote machine and sign in, and its agents show up next to your local ones.
